description: Turns a clip of a video (at most 60 s) into an animated GIF with ffmpeg on this machine, using a palette made for that clip. Pick the part with start/end; frame rate and width keep the file small. Needs ffmpeg installed.

end.description: Seconds (default: the end of the video, at most 60 s after start)

name: video_to_gif
title: GIF from a video
